style: Macro photograph of a real miniature precision-machined electronic device, physically based polished metal, anodised aluminium, glossy plastic and glass, fine machining marks and tiny screws, high detail

items.subject: A small round hovering courier robot about the size of a fist: a smooth polished gold and brass spherical body like a vintage pocket-watch casing, a wide glowing cyan glass visor band across the front as its single eye, two short stubby rounded arms with small gripper hands, a tiny brass antenna on top, a small rounded cargo pouch on its back, and a round chrome hover thruster disk underneath instead of legs, cheerful friendly design, facing forward

A small menacing hovering security drone robot: a rounded dome-shaped body of glossy candy-red anodised aluminium with a short skirt of overlapping red metal plates hanging around its base, a horizontal black glass visor slit with a single bright white sensor eye across the front, a sharp swept-back red fin crest on top, two small side thruster pods, no legs, facing forward

A small sly hovering security drone robot: a rounded dome-shaped body of glossy violet-purple anodised aluminium with a scalloped skirt of overlapping violet metal plates hanging around its base, a narrow black glass visor slit with a white sensor eye across the front, two small curved horns on top of the dome, slim side thruster pods, no legs, facing forward

A small jittery hovering security drone robot: a rounded dome-shaped body of glossy lime-green anodised aluminium with a wavy skirt of overlapping green metal plates hanging around its base, a black glass visor slit with a white sensor eye across the front, a small three-point metal tiara crown on top, little side thruster pods, no legs, facing forward

A small timid hovering security drone robot: a rounded dome-shaped body of glossy amber-orange anodised aluminium with a skirt of overlapping orange metal plates hanging around its base, a black glass visor slit with a white sensor eye across the front, two thin springy antennae with tiny ball tips on top, little side thruster pods, no legs, facing forward

A single upright radial electrolytic capacitor component standing on its two short legs: a tall brushed aluminium cylindrical can with a dark blue heat-shrink plastic sleeve covering the sides, a silver stripe down one side, a stamped cross-shaped vent on the flat aluminium top, a black rubber seal at the bottom

A single square extruded aluminium heatsink block from a circuit board, many thin tall parallel cooling fins rising from a thick flat base plate, dark grey anodised finish with bright machined edges on the fin tips, a small black processor chip clamped underneath, roughly as tall as it is wide
